name: Whisked to the World of my Ex’s Favourite Trashy Shoujo Novel Just to Kill the Monarchy
source:
Aries Mariano - full time college student and part-time Twitter warrior - is introduced to the book The Red String Between Us by her best friend (and ex) Catherine during a reunion sleepover. 

She eventually falls asleep reading it midway, only to wake up in Alexandria, the world of the novel. 

Summoned by the villainess, Lysithea Du Pont, to help recruit Prince Alexios IX in an ongoing coup d'etat against the ruling King and Queen, Ares has to navigate through this unfamiliar new world and deal with politics, personal issues, and maybe even love.

[From [url=https://leycalate.itch.io/whiskill]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
白羊座·马里亚诺 - 全日制大学生和兼职推特战士 - 在团聚过夜期间，她最好的朋友（也是前任）凯瑟琳向她介绍了《我们之间的红线》一书。

她最终在读到一半时睡着了，醒来时发现自己身处小说的世界亚历山大。

阿瑞斯受到恶棍莉西西娅·杜邦的召唤，帮助招募阿历克修斯九世王子参与一场针对执政国王和王后的持续政变，阿瑞斯必须在这个陌生的新世界中航行，处理政治、个人问题，甚至可能还有爱情。
